Description: Cost-safe AWS production foundation and authenticated admin API for admintonibover.

GuardrailsEvidenceConfirmed.Description: Required acknowledgement that the private account, identity, billing, Region, and resource baseline were rechecked immediately before this change set.

Environment.Description: This artifact permits only the isolated production environment.

AllowedOrigins.ConstraintDescription: Each production origin must be one exact HTTPS origin, without paths or wildcards.
AllowedOrigins.Description: Exact production admin origins for API Gateway and S3 CORS. Do not use wildcards.

CallbackUrls.ConstraintDescription: Each production callback must be an exact HTTPS URL ending in /auth/callback, without wildcards.
CallbackUrls.Description: Exact production Cognito authorization-code callback URLs.

LogoutUrls.ConstraintDescription: Each production logout URL must be an exact HTTPS origin with a trailing slash, without wildcards.
LogoutUrls.Description: Exact production Cognito logout redirect URLs.

CognitoDomainPrefix.ConstraintDescription: Use a globally unique 3-63 character lowercase prefix containing only letters, numbers, and internal hyphens.
CognitoDomainPrefix.Description: Globally unique prefix for the production Cognito managed-login domain.

ExistingSuperAdminUsername.ConstraintDescription: Use the exact private Username returned by Cognito list-users.
ExistingSuperAdminUsername.Description: Existing confirmed administrator to attach to super-admins before group enforcement is updated.

Assertions.AssertDescription: Recheck the private account, identity, billing, Region, and resource baseline before deploying.

Properties.Description: Full content access and eligibility for user management.

Scopes.ScopeDescription: Access to the authenticated admintonibover admin API

Properties.Description: Least-privilege execution role for the production foundation Lambda.
Authenticated post, taxonomy, backup, and private media operations for the production admin.
